subject.title: feat(subagents): native announceTarget for subagent completion routing (#27445)

question: Should OpenClaw expose `sessions_spawn(announceTarget: "parent")` as a supported native mode that deliberately suppresses external delivery when the requester wake-up cannot be completed?
rationale: The implementation is intentionally fail-closed and model-visible; an automated reviewer cannot decide whether potentially withholding a completion from an external channel is the intended product tradeoff for detached fan-in workflows.

options.title: Approve the bounded native mode
options.body: Accept the explicit per-spawn, no-fallback parent route after the branch is rebased and current-head behavior proof confirms default, parent, and restart cases.

options.title: Keep current delivery semantics only
options.body: Decline the public parameter and keep orchestration on the existing completion-delivery contract until a broader owner-designed workflow surface is chosen.

options.title: Move to a different orchestration API
options.body: Ask for a narrower owner-designed parent-handoff API if the desired contract should not be expressed as a `sessions_spawn` option.

recommendation.title: Approve the bounded native mode
recommendation.body: Accept the explicit per-spawn, no-fallback parent route after the branch is rebased and current-head behavior proof confirms default, parent, and restart cases.

likelyOwner.reason: The affected surface spans core agent delivery semantics, model-facing tool contracts, and persisted state, so it needs a core product owner’s decision.
